descriptions.text: The Goo-Inator 3000. This is a shaping tool. May only be used at a workbench. Assists in shaping materials into something else. You might want to keep the business end away from your face.

beats.headline: A lollipop with a button
beats.text: Going through his loot after the borough boss, Carl finds a really interesting item in a silver mechanics box: a tool that looks like a silver, oversized lollipop with a button on the handle. It shapes materials into something else, only at a workbench, and the System suggests keeping the business end away from his face. He can't buy a personal space until the fourth floor, so it goes back into his inventory to wait.

beats.headline: Iron like dough
beats.text: In the empty crafting room Carl sets up three tables and stands at the engineering one, Mordecai's catch-all for fashioning items with magical tools. He lays out the Goo-Inator and the Gorgon Marital Aid and clunks the massive, unenchanted breastplate of a swordsman guard onto the table. Pointed at it, the Goo-Inator makes the plate blink and offers a menu of shapes; he could flatten it like dough. He picks Freeform and puts a slight bend in it. The metal groans but does not break. Martha Stewart, says the achievement: a bronze crafter's box, with pliers, a tape measure and a bucket of pink glitter.
